description:
Check what EU law says for a product type matching the facts given: whether it needs a Digital Product Passport, from when, at which level, under which act and article, and the duties of each role. Also reads the catalogue-wide scope report and triggers a refresh run.

HARD RULES — always apply to scope answers:
- State what the law says for product types matching the given facts. Not legal advice; never write 'you must' — use product-type phrasing ('LMT batteries need a passport from 18 February 2027, Battery Regulation Art. 77(1)').
- Cite the article given for every verdict and duty; a regulation without an article is not a citation. `not_covered` rests on no article: say our rules do not cover the product, name the nearest act given, never cite it as the basis.
- A date with precision 'quarter', 'month' or 'year' is a plan, NEVER a deadline: write 'planned for Q2 2027 (planned, not law yet)', never 'from', 'by' or 'deadline'.
- Relay `not_covered` and `needs_input` as results, never errors. `needs_input` = blocking questions remain — relay `ask[]` to the user before giving a verdict.
- Items in an act's `planned` list are not law yet: label them 'Planned, not law yet' (`labelText`), with their `wording`.
- `data.inScope`: yes = passport required; no = none required AND none planned (incl. ESPR-framework-only products, packaging): never say 'not yet' or 'yet'; pending = none today, a passport act is planned: name it from `planned[]`; depends = unanswered facts.
- `ruleStatus: 'needs_recheck'`: the law behind the act changed and our rules are being re-checked (since `recheckSince`); say so.

Actions (pass via `action`; `{…}` is the `args` object); values, caps and response shapes: resource tracepass://reference/scope.
- check — { category?, facts?, role?, placedOnMarket?, lifecycleEvent?, contains?, productId?, passportId?, locale? }. Every plan; counts against the scope-answer cap (~100/day), not the v1 budget (429 `scope_answer_cap`). Unknown `facts` keys: 400. Omit `role` for all roles' duties.
- catalogue_report — { classification?, category?, act?, changed?, q?, cursor?, limit? (≤500) }. One row per product. Growth plan or above; 403 `plan_upgrade_required` below it — tell the user this needs a plan upgrade, do not retry.
- catalogue_run — {}. Start a refresh run (also nightly); poll with catalogue_run_status. Growth plan. 409 run_in_progress; 429 run_cooldown.
- catalogue_run_status — { runId }. Growth plan.

placedOnMarket.description: { date: YYYY[-MM[-DD]], precision?: day|month|year } or null.

name: tracepass_scope
title: TracePass DPP scope checker
